route.selection: a peer uses these schemas only with trusted capability composition; the v1 push schema is unchanged and still rejects both types

receiptLookup.selection: same capabilities as push; a found result may be any v1 or A06 accepted result or a terminal rejection, and legacy results remain valid

businessSource.scope: backendNamespace + authenticated app + authenticated platform user
backendNamespace + authenticated app + authenticated platform user

registry: contracts/v1/operations.json is a pinned G1 artifact; these entries are the additive registry for the two types and do not edit it

store_offer_not_found.meaning: offerId is unknown or not bound to the authenticated app; never reveals another app's offer

store_offer_version_mismatch.meaning: offerVersion is not the offer's current purchasable version

store_offer_unavailable.meaning: the offer version exists but is retired or not purchasable for this player

store_insufficient_balance.meaning: confirmed balance of the price currency is below the server price at commit

store_purchase_limit_reached.meaning: the server purchase limit for this player and offer is already consumed at commit

store_purchase_key_conflict.meaning: purchaseKey already committed a purchase with a different offerId or offerVersion

quest_not_found.meaning: questId is unknown or not bound to the authenticated app

quest_not_claimable.meaning: occurrenceKey is not a completed, unexpired occurrence of questId issued to this player

value_limit_exceeded.meaning: a grant line would exceed the checked signed64 maximum; nothing commits

rejectionCodes.all: terminal_rejected with retryable=false in the unchanged G1 error envelope; a terminal rejection commits no value, source reservation or feed change

idempotency.operation: the same operationId returns the stored immutable result (G1)
idempotency.sameSource: another operationId for a committed source with the same payloadBinding is accepted with the originating result: same purchaseId/claimId, lines, feedRevision and originatingOperationId, and no second debit, grant or feed change
idempotency.changedBinding: another operationId reusing purchaseKey with a different offerId/offerVersion is store_purchase_key_conflict; a questId that does not own occurrenceKey is quest_not_claimable
idempotency.noAlreadyClaimedCode: a claimed occurrence returns the originating claim rather than a rejection
idempotency.concurrency: commands for one player serialize on the private feed head; of concurrent operations for one source exactly one commits the value effect
idempotency.purchaseKey: client-generated UUIDv7 per purchase intent, persisted in the pending command before first send; a separate legitimate purchase uses a new key
idempotency.order: after operation identity replay, look up the committed business source first; an existing source returns the originating result or the binding conflict before any offer, quest, balance or limit check

fingerprint.semanticEncoding: unchanged gindemit-canonical-command-v1 framing and included fields
fingerprint.schema: normalization is directed by store-quest.schema.json#/$defs/operation instead of the v1 push operation
fingerprint.purchaseKey: a canonical lowercase UUID text or exactly 16 RFC-order MessagePack binary bytes normalizes to canonical lowercase UUID text with the string tag; other text or binary lengths are rejected before hashing
fingerprint.otherFields: offerId, questId and occurrenceKey are strings; offerVersion is an integer tag
fingerprint.runtime: the frozen backend fingerprinter is bound to the v1 operation schema and cannot compute these vectors unchanged; cross-runtime computation is unverified

valueEffects.purchase: debit the server-pinned price (currencyId, quantity) of offerId@offerVersion, then apply the server reward plan lines of that version in lineIndex order; the client never supplies price, discount, reward or quantity
valueEffects.claim: apply the server reward lines of the occurrence in lineIndex order; no debit
valueEffects.lines: reuse live-slice receipt currencyLine (wallet) and stackLine (inventory); entitlement lines are excluded
valueEffects.projection: one atomic feed group at feedRevision carrying the resulting v1 walletUpsert/inventoryUpsert per changed entity; a debit and grant of one currency net into one upsert; no projection schema change
valueEffects.balances: wallet balance and inventory quantity stay checked nonnegative signed64; result quantities are historical and never mutate client state directly, bootstrap/pull owns confirmed value

atomicity.unit: debit, purchase or claim record, every grant line, operation result and feed group commit in one server transaction
atomicity.faults: a fault after the debit or after any single grant line rolls back everything; no partial value, record or feed change is observable
atomicity.clientOutcome: a rolled-back attempt surfaces as retryable (G1 envelope, retryable=true) or a transport failure; retrying the same operationId executes once

authorization: derive account only from verified authentication
offer, quest and occurrence must be bound to the authenticated app and, for occurrences, issued to the authenticated player
authorization failures never enumerate another account's or app's offers, occurrences, purchases or claims

runtimeMappings.uuids: operationId, originatingOperationId, purchaseId, claimId, purchaseKey are bin16 RFC order in MessagePack, lowercase text in JSON
runtimeMappings.signed64: debit and line quantity, feedRevision are C# long / TS bigint, decimal strings in JSON
runtimeMappings.unknown: unknown fields, kinds, codes and schema versions fail closed

exclusions: no real-money purchase, store receipt validation or payment provider
no new REST route; offer listing, quest listing and claim status reads are not exposed
no objective engine or quest progress evaluation; a claimable occurrence is trusted server state
no rotation, scheduling, eligibility rules or availability windows beyond the server claimable/purchasable decision
no runtime codec, endpoint, migration or feature implementation

compatibility.preserved: all 90 core, 4 G2 live-slice and 4 G3 checkpoint artifacts remain byte-identical
compatibility.legacyClients: clients on the v1 push schema never send the new types; servers without the capability return upgrade_required_nonterminal
compatibility.fingerprint: unchanged gindemit-canonical-command-v1; payload fields are included generically
